result.rationale: The diff removes `embed_category` from site_settings.yml where its default was `''`; Discourse does not persist empty-default settings as rows in the site_settings table, so `execute("SELECT ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]` returns nil on installs that never customized it, and calling `['id']` on nil raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration before any hosts are migrated. The `embeddable_hosts` default was also `''`, making this the common case, not an edge case.
